description: Amendment to planning permission ref: 2017/00363/FUL granted 16th March 2017 for the ' Erection of a rear extension at first floor level, on top of the existing back addition; erection of a single storey rear extension to the side of the existing back addition; increasing the height of the roof of first floor back addition; replacement of existing timber windows to the rear elevation with powder-coated aluminium windows.' Amendments to include the installation of a new window to the side of rear back addition at first floor level, replacement of front timber framed windows with aluminium framed windows, amendments to the window opening styles on the side (north) and rear elevations, alterations to the positions of windows in the rear dormer, removal of existing flat roof window, alterations to the sizes and positions of front elevation roof windows, alterations to glazed doors at rear elevation on ground floor, alterations to the design of the rooflight and installation of an additional roof light above the roof of single storey back addition.
